name: qfd_native59_dv_service-n1-COMMIT
purpose: dv2f14 W-column die master qfd_native59_dv_service (Q-N59 dd73225e0 RTL as on q-die11b af607c367): flat tile in the dv2f14bn slot, top-down faces/order, ports widened to <=6/um over the full face

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_native59_dv_service u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_dv_service.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_command_context.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_q_export_control.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_static_service.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_native59_record_endpoint.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_kvn_static_transport.sv rtl/qwen_sys/redesign_qwen/ot_qfd_su_kv_static_posted.sv rtl/qwen_sys/split_20261014/qkd_native_attention_record.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_native59_dv_service/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_native59_dv_service/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_native59_dv_service --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_native59_dv_service  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
